# oneuptime_proxmox_cluster (Resource)

Proxmox cluster resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_proxmox_cluster" "example" {
  name = "Example short text"
}
```

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource. Computed.
